rfc: §15.1 (F1 payload enum Vacuity: NON_VACUOUS, VACUOUS, INDETERMINATE); invariant IX

model.reconstruction: a copy of the candidate (.git and caches aside) minus the story's added product files, with every other story product hunk reverse-applied exactly at its candidate position; a deleted product file rebuilt from the content the patch carries; test files the story owns and everything outside the story diff copied untouched
model.attribution: per intended case (story-owned, passed at the candidate): 'failed' in the neutralised run attributes; 'error', a skip, a missing case or a collection failure does not
model.parent: no parameter, no path, no git: the runner's cwd is the controller's scratch copy (kernel rule CANDIDATE_ONLY_EXECUTION, invariant IX)
